title: Robustness of mKdV Breathers: A Numerical Perspective
summary: We systematically investigate breather solutions in the modified Korteweg-de Vries (mKdV) equation via numerical simulations. We show that the breather solutions are stable under a variety of perturbations, including amplitude changes, modifications of internal parameters, and perturbations of the nonlinearity of the equation.
